texts.zh:
一个研究团队提出了一项新议案，将监管人工智能集成到我们的移动设备中，随后又可以直接整合进义体件中。

这些监管人工智能将会引导我们公民将关注点从无聊的任务转移到更需要脑力的任务上。虽然会因此丧失一部分自主权，但对生产力前所未有的提高将不容忽视。
texts.en:
A team of researchers has put forth an innovative proposal to integrate AI supervisors into our mobile devices. Later these could be incorporated directly into cyberware.

The supervisors would redirect the focus of our citizenry away from idle tasks towards more cerebral endeavors. While some level of autonomy will be lost, the unprecedented potential to amplify our productivity cannot be overlooked.

label.zh: 我们当将此视为一项恩赐。
label.en: We must accept this as a blessing.

label.zh: 这对自主权的牺牲太大了。
label.en: The loss of autonomy is too great.

label.zh: 我们不会在远离神圣的道路上越行越远的。
label.en: We will not stray further from the holy path.

label.zh: 如果能装上一键开关的话这是可以接受的。
label.en: Acceptable, if an On/Off switch is included.

label.zh: 这将给我们带来多少的控制权啊……
label.en: The amount of control this will grant us...

summary.text:
# 精神减负 / Mental Offload

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 网络化局势（Cyberization）每月运行隐藏事件 cyber.5，从 on_cyberization_situation_random_events_list 中等权重（各1）抽取一个满足条件的随机事件（共7个：120、160、210、220、260、320、360）；事件期间设置 situation_cyberization_pause 暂停局势，结束后移除。
  The Cyberization situation runs hidden cyber.5 monthly, which draws one valid event with equal weight (1 each) from on_cyberization_situation_random_events_list (seven events: 120, 160, 210, 220, 260, 320, 360); the event sets situation_cyberization_pause while open and removes it afterwards.
- 触发：局势进度>450；每局至多一次（cyber_120_happened）。
  Trigger: situation progress > 450; at most once (cyber_120_happened).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「精神外包」（机会）：研究员提议把AI监督者集成进设备和植入物。选项（非灵性与灵性各一对）：优先生产力 → AI_control 修正（灵性者需付500团结）；拒绝自主性损失；附开关则每月团结；唯物主义者得工程研究并取得 moderate_AI_control；威权者得工程研究并取得 AI_forced_control。
  "Mental Offload" (opportunity): researchers propose AI supervisors in devices and implants. Options (spiritualist and non-spiritualist pairs): productivity first -> AI_control modifier (spiritualists pay 500 unity); refuse the loss of autonomy; with an on/off switch, monthly unity; materialists gain engineering research and moderate_AI_control; authoritarians gain engineering research and AI_forced_control.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口（无后续或只通向共享结局）；选项互斥，只能选一个。
  A single window (no follow-up, or only into the shared ending); options are exclusive, only one is chosen.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项集合随帝国的伦理、权威、政体特质而变，见条件。
  The available options vary with ethics, authority and civics, see the conditions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/machine_age_situation_events_1.txt:328-475`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`
- 已核对：来源池与权重、触发条件、选项分支与目标事件。
  Checked: source pool and weights, trigger conditions, option branches and target events.
- 未逐行核对选项的数值收益，只记录其性质（修正名、资源、标志）。
  Option numbers were not checked line by line; only their nature (modifier names, resources, flags) is recorded.
